summary: Two cool inflation prints in two days lit a fire under stocks. July PPI came in flat this morning, a touch softer than the small rise the street looked for, and the Nasdaq ran with it. MNQ pushed through the 30,000 psych, tagged a fresh session high at 30,273, and closed +1.37% at 30,216 with its trend stop rising underneath. MES tracked it step for step, +0.76% to 7,825. Gold and crude went the other way: gold spiked overnight, failed, and closed down 1.38% while flipping short on its trend line, and crude stayed the lone energy drag at 81.20.
psychology: Two green days in a row after big news is where overconfidence sneaks in. The temptation Friday is to size up because the trend looks obvious. The trend looking obvious is exactly why the easy part of the move is already behind us. Trade the levels in front of you, keep your size the same as any other day, and let the market prove a third day before you press. Retail Sales hits at 8:30 AM ET, so give the first hour room before committing.

event.nqReaction: NQ extended the post-CPI risk-on run, cleared the 30,000 psych, tagged a 30,273 RTH high, and closed +1.37% at 30,216.
event.crossAsset: VIX flat near 14.6. Gold down 1.38% and silver down 1.27% as the haven bid faded. Crude down 1.68%. The 10-year yield eased toward 4.64% on the cool print.

risk.note: Week ahead: Retail Sales and University of Michigan sentiment both land Friday Aug 14 (8:30 AM and 10:00 AM ET). Two data points into the weekend after a two-day risk-on run. Keep size normal, respect the 8:30 print, and do not chase a third green day before the market earns it. Not financial advice.
